sections.skill: Find a quadratic through three points with a matrix equation

questions.skill: Find a quadratic through three points with a matrix equation
questions.standard_level: Precalculus. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Precalculus, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: y = ax² + bx + c passes through (0, 1), (1, 2), and (2, 7). Write the system for a, b, and c as a matrix equation AX = B, with X the column [a, b, c]. Give A and B.
questions.prompt_markup:
y = ax² + bx + c passes through (0, 1), (1, 2), and (2, 7).
Write the system for a, b, and c as a matrix equation AX = B, with X the column [a, b, c]. Give A and B.
questions.correct_answer: A has rows [0 0 1], [1 1 1], and [4 2 1]; B is the column [1, 2, 7].
questions.grading_note: Form required: A and B. Each point (x, y) gives the row [x² x 1] and the constant y.

questions.skill: Find a quadratic through three points with a matrix equation
questions.standard_level: Precalculus. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Precalculus, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: A has rows [0 0 1], [1 1 1], and [4 2 1], X is the column [a, b, c], and B is the column [1, 2, 7]. Solve AX = B to find the parabola y = ax² + bx + c.
questions.prompt_markup: A has rows [0 0 1], [1 1 1], and [4 2 1], X is the column [a, b, c], and B is the column [1, 2, 7]. Solve AX = B to find the parabola y = ax² + bx + c.
questions.grading_note: Form required: all three values (or the equation). c = 1, a + b = 1, and 4a + 2b = 6, so 2a = 4.

questions.skill: Find a quadratic through three points with a matrix equation
questions.standard_level: Precalculus. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Precalculus, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: A parabola y = ax² + bx + c passes through (0, 1), (1, 2), and (2, 7). It is written as AX = B with X the column [a, b, c]. Which row of A comes from the point (2, 7)?
questions.prompt_markup:
A parabola y = ax² + bx + c passes through (0, 1), (1, 2), and (2, 7). It is written as AX = B with X the column [a, b, c].
Which row of A comes from the point (2, 7)?
questions.grading_note: 4a + 2b + c = 7, so the row is [4 2 1] and the matching entry of B is 7.
